description: This Java class defines a command for deleting a policy within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from policy IDs or JSON, and handles serialization/deserialization of the delete policy command.

classes.name: DeletePolicy
classes.description: A command class for deleting a policy, including serialization/deserialization and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DeletePolicy command from a PolicyId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a DeletePolicy command from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId of the policy to delete.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path for the command, empty in this case.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the policy ID to the JSON payload.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new DeletePolicy instance with updated headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object can be equal to this instance.

methods.description: Returns the hash code of the object.
